script.text: ---- Returns the stack path in a usable format for file managment--function getStackPath-- the long name of the stack is-- stack "[stack path]"-- the stack path is-- disk name:[folder name:]+[short name of stack]--put "" into thePathput the long name of this stack into thePath-- find the first quote and delete up to it.put offset(quote, thePath) into theQuoteif theQuote > 0 thendelete char 1 to theQuote of thePath-- find the last quote and delete short name of the stack and quoteput offset(quote, thePath) into theQuoteif theQuote > 0 thendelete char (theQuote - 1 - length(the short name of this stack)) to theQuote of thePathend ifend ifreturn thePathend getStackPath---- Retrieve words from a file to be loaded into fields--function loadWords stackPath, fileNameput empty into theWordsput stackPath & ":" & fileName into filePathopen file filePathif the result is empty thenrepeatset the cursor to busyread from file filePath for 16384 -- maximum read is 16Kif it is empty then exit repeatelse put it after theWordsend repeatclose file filePathelseanswer "Error opening file " & filePath & ". The error is: " & the resultend ifset the cursor to handreturn theWordsend loadWords---- Return the center point of a rect--function centerPoint theRectput item 1 of theRect into theLeftput item 2 of theRect into theTopput item 3 of theRect into theRightput item 4 of theRect into theBottomput (theLeft + round((theRight - theLeft) / 2)) & "," & ¬(theTop + round((theBottom - theTop) / 2)) into thePointreturn thePointend centerPoint---- Draw a line between two points--on drawLine startPoint, endPointchoose line toolset lineSize to 2drag from startPoint to endPointchoose browse toolend drawLine---- Erase a line drawn between two points--on eraseLine startPoint, endPointchoose eraser tooldrag from startPoint to endPointchoose browse toolend eraseLine---- Exit to hypercard if the user performs a mouse click-- Used to allow exiting a long process such as drawing a chart--on checkUserCancelif the mouseClick thenchoose browse toolexit to hyperCardend ifend checkUserCancel

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Hyper-Wordle-- _SDGOL_---- Set global variable gDebug to true if you are debugging the code--------------------------------------------------------------------------------on openCardglobal gDebugglobal gCodeput false into gDebugput false into gCodeset the name of card button ID 125 to "Gaming"if gDebug is true thenshow card button ID 125show card button "load"show card button "reset"show card field "row"show card field "col"show card field "word"show card field "we won"show card field "game number"show card field "words"show card field "acceptable 1"show card field "acceptable 2"show card field "acceptable 3"elsehide card button ID 125hide card button "load"hide card button "reset"hide card field "row"hide card field "col"hide card field "word"hide card field "we won"hide card field "game number"hide card field "words"hide card field "acceptable 1"hide card field "acceptable 2"hide card field "acceptable 3"end ifend openCard---- Reset the game to start over as if never played--on resetGamesetGame(0) -- set the game number to zeroresetStats -- rest stats to zeronewGame -- start a new gameend resetGame---- Start a new game--on newGameput getGame() into theGamesetGame(theGame + 1) -- next gamesetWord("") -- clear the user's wordsetWeWon(false) -- haven't won yetresetTiles -- reset the tiles-- set the row and column to the first tilesetRow(1)setCol(1)resetKeyboardLetters -- reset the keyboard lettersend newGame---- Reset the game tiles--on resetTilesrepeat with i = 1 to 6repeat with j = 1 to 5put getBox(i,j) into letterFieldput "" into card field letterFieldset textStyle of card field letterField to outlineset style of card field letterField to rectangleend repeatend repeatend resetTiles---- Capture a key press and handle it----on keyDown theKeyglobal gCodeif gCode is false thenput getWeWon() into weWonif weWon = false thenput charToNum of theKey into keyNum -- get the number cooresponding to the keyput getWord() into theWord -- get the user's guess wordif keyNum = 3 or keyNum = 13 then -- enter or return key pressedhandleEnterKeyelse if keyNum = 8 then -- delete key presseddeleteLetterelse if length of theWord < 5 then-- we are still looking for game lettersif keyNum >= (charToNum of "a") and keyNum <= (charToNum of "z") then-- [a-z] key pressed-- convert to upper caseput numToChar of (keyNum + (charToNum of "A" - charToNum of "a")) into theLetteraddLetter theLetterelse if keyNum >= (charToNum of "A") and keyNum <= (charToNum of "Z") then-- [A-Z] key pressedaddLetter theKeyelsepass keyDownend ifelsepass keyDownend ifelsepass keyDownend ifelsepass keyDownend ifend keyDown---- Handle the enter key press--on handleEnterKeyput getRow() into theRowput getCol() into theColput getWord() into theWord -- the user's guess wordput getMatch() into theMatch -- the game word to matchif length of theWord is 5 then-- test the user's guess wordif theWord = theMatch then-- the user's guess word and the game word match. It's a winner!weWon-- set the tiles to shadow stylelock screenrepeat with j = 1 to 5put getBox(theRow,j) into letterFieldset the style of card field letterField to shadowset the textStyle of card field letterField to boldsetKeyboardLetter (character j of theWord), trueend repeatunlock screenelse if acceptableWord(theWord) is true then -- it is an accepted word-- set the tile styles for each letter tile--lock screenrepeat with j = 1 to 5put getBox(theRow,j) into letterFieldanimateTile theRow, jif character j of theWord = character j of theMatch then-- in word and correct placeset the textStyle of card field letterField to boldsetKeyboardLetter (character j of theWord), trueelse if theMatch contains character j of theWord then-- in word and wrong placeset the textStyle of card field letterField to outline, shadowsetKeyboardLetter (character j of theWord), trueelse-- not in wordset the textStyle of card field letterField to outlinesetKeyboardLetter(character j of theWord), falseend ifend repeat--unlock screen with visual effect dissolve fast-- if we finish the 6th row without matching, we've lostif theRow = 6 thenweLost(theMatch)elsenextRow -- move to the first col of the next rowend ifelse -- not an accepted word-- flash shadow style a couple of times and clear the tilesrepeat for two times-- switch to shadow stylelock screenrepeat with j = 1 to 5put getBox(theRow,j) into letterFieldset the style of card field letterField to shadowend repeatunlock screen-- switch back to rectangle stylelock screenrepeat with j = 1 to 5put getBox(theRow,j) into letterFieldset the style of card field letterField to rectangleend repeatunlock screenend repeat-- clear the letter tilesrepeat with j = 1 to 5put getBox(theRow,j) into letterFieldput "" into card field letterFieldend repeatsetCol(1) -- go back to the first column tilesetWord "" -- try againend ifsetWord ""end ifend handleEnterKeyon animateTile theRow, theCol-- flip the tile for a visual queueend animateTile---- Is the word in the acceptable word lists--function acceptableWord theWordif card field "words" contains theWord ¬or card field "acceptable 1" contains theWord ¬or card field "acceptable 2" contains theWord ¬or card field "acceptable 3" contains theWord thenreturn trueend ifreturn falseend acceptableWord---- move to the previous letter box if possible--on previousBoxput getRow() into iput getCol() into jif j = 1 and i = 1 then-- startelseif j = 1 thenput 5 into jput i - 1 into ielseput j - 1 into jend ifsetRow(i)setCol(j)end ifend previousBox---- move to the next letter box if possible--on nextColput getCol() into theColif theCol < 5 thensetCol(theCol + 1)end ifend nextCol---- determine the current box name from the current position--function getCurrentBoxput "letter " & getRow() & getCol() into letterFieldreturn letterFieldend getCurrentBox---- Get the tile at row, col--function getBox theRow, theColput "letter " & theRow & theCol into letterFieldreturn letterFieldend getBox---- Reset keyboard letters--on resetKeyboardLettersrepeat with theKey = charToNum("A") to charToNum("Z")set the textStyle of card field ("letter " & numToChar(theKey)) to plainshow card field ("letter " & numToChar(theKey))end repeatend resetKeyboardLetters---- Set a keyboard letter--on setKeyboardLetter theLetter, letterInif letterIn = true thenset the textStyle of card field ("letter " & theLetter) to boldelse--set the textStyle of card field ("letter " & theLetter) to outlinehide card field ("letter " & theLetter)end ifend setKeyboardLetter---- Go to the next row--on nextRowput getRow() into theRowif theRow < 6 thensetRow (theRow + 1)setCol(1)end ifend nextRow---- Handle winning--on weWonsetWeWon(true)put getWins() into theWinsput getStreak() into theStreakput getPlays() into thePlaysput getRow() into theRow-- set winning statssetWins(theWins + 1)setStreak(theStreak + 1)setPlays(thePlays + 1)incWinRow(theRow)end weWon---- Handle loosing--on weLost theWordsetWeWon(false)put getLosses() into theLossesput getPlays() into thePlays-- set loosing statssetLosses(theLosses + 1)setPlays(thePlays + 1)setStreak(0)answer "Sorry, the word is " & quote & theWord & quote & ". Play again?" ¬with "OK" or "Cancel"if it is "OK" thennewGameend ifend weLost---- Reset stats--on resetStatsrepeat with theRow = 1 to 6setWinRow theRow, 0end repeatsetPlays(0)setWins(0)setLosses(0)setStreak(0)setMaxStreak(0)end resetStats---- Add a letter to the word--on addLetter theLetterput getWord() & theLetter into theWordsetWord(theWord)displayLetter theLetternextColend addLetter---- Delete a letter from the word--on deleteLetterput getWord() into theWordput length of theWord into theLengthif length = 0 thensetWord("")setCol(1)elseput char 1 to theLength - 1 of theWord into theWordsetWord(theWord)setCol(length of theWord + 1)displayLetter ""end ifend deleteLetter---- display the letter in the current tile--on displayLetter theLetterput getCurrentBox() into theBoxput theLetter into card field theBoxend displayLetter---- Get the current game word--function getMatchput getGame() into theGamereturn the first word of line theGame of card field "words"end getMatch---- Get/Set functions--function getRowreturn card field "row"end getRowfunction getColreturn card field "col"end getColon setRow theRowput theRow into card field "row"end setRowon setCol theColput theCol into card field "col"end setColon setWeWon theWeWonput theWeWon into card field "we won"end setWeWonfunction getWeWonreturn card field "we won"end getWeWonon setGame theGameput theGame into card field "game number"end setGamefunction getGamereturn card field "game number"end getGameon setWinRow theRow, theValueput theValue into line ((6 - theRow) mod 6 + 1) of background field "data" of card "stats"end setWinRowon incWinRow theRowput line ((6 - theRow) mod 6 + 1) of background field "data" of card "stats" into theRowWinsif theRowWins is empty or theRowWins = 0 thenput 0 into theRowWinsend ifput theRowWins + 1 into theRowWinsput theRowWins into line ((6 - theRow) mod 6 + 1) of background field "data" of card "stats"end incWinRowfunction getPlaysput card field "plays" of card "stats" into theValueif theValue is empty or theValue = "" thenput 0 into theValueend ifreturn theValueend getPlayson setPlays theValueput theValue into card field "plays" of card "stats"end setPlaysfunction getWinsput card field "wins" of card "stats" into theValueif theValue is empty or theValue = "" thenput 0 into theValueend ifreturn theValueend getWinson setWins theValueput theValue into card field "wins" of card "stats"end setWinsfunction getLossesput card field "losses" of card "stats" into theValueif theValue is empty or theValue = "" thenput 0 into theValueend ifreturn theValueend getLosseson setLosses theValueput theValue into card field "losses" of card "stats"end setLossesfunction getStreakput card field "streak" of card "stats" into theValueif theValue is empty or theValue = "" thenput 0 into theValueend ifreturn theValueend getStreakon setStreak theStreakput getMaxStreak() into theMaxStreakput theStreak into card field "streak" of card "stats"if theStreak > theMaxStreak thensetMaxStreak(theStreak)end ifend setStreakfunction getMaxStreakput card field "max streak" of card "stats" into theValueif theValue is empty or theValue = "" thenput 0 into theValueend ifreturn theValueend getMaxStreakon setMaxStreak theValueput theValue into card field "max streak" of card "stats"end setMaxStreakfunction getWordreturn card field "word"end getWordon setWord theWordput theWord into card field "word"end setWord
